variants.text: Middle-aged female with an oval face, thin soft-arched eyebrows, almond-shaped eyes with double eyelids, and a nose with a straight dorsum and rounded tip.

Middle-aged female with an oval face shape, thin soft-arched eyebrows, almond-shaped eyes with double eyelids, and a nose with a straight dorsum and rounded tip. She has balanced lip fullness and a medium-width mouth with visible upper teeth.

Middle-aged female with an oval face shape, moderate soft tissue coverage, and no discernible persistent asymmetries. The forehead is of moderate height and width. Eyebrows are thin and soft-arched. Eyes are almond-shaped with horizontal canthal tilt and double eyelids. The nose features a straight dorsum, average root width, and rounded tip. The mouth is medium width with balanced lip fullness and visible upper teeth at rest. The skin is clear.

This is a middle-aged woman with an oval face. She has thin, arched eyebrows and almond-shaped eyes with visible double eyelids. Her nose is straight with a rounded tip, and her mouth is a medium width with balanced lips, showing her upper teeth.
